output_file.description: Atlas entities emitted by transform: one Connection (unless connection_usage=REUSE), then APISpec, then APIPath records.

fields.name: typeName
fields.description: Atlas type of the entity on this line — Connection, APISpec or APIPath. Mandatory on every Atlas asset.

fields.name: attributes
fields.description: Atlas nested-format attribute bag; every asset field other than the Atlas envelope lives in here.

fields.name: attributes.qualifiedName
fields.description: Atlan qualified name; the identity publish-app upserts on. Formats are documented in app/asset_mapper.py.

fields.name: attributes.name
fields.description: Human-readable asset name shown in the Atlan UI. Mandatory on every Atlas asset.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Atlas entity status, stamped ACTIVE by apply_sync_metadata. Absent on Connection lines, which do not go through it.

fields.name: attributes.tenantId
fields.description: Owning tenant, stamped by apply_sync_metadata. Absent on Connection lines.

fields.name: attributes.lastSyncRun
fields.description: Temporal workflow ID of the run that produced this asset; how downstream diffing scopes a run. Absent on Connection lines.

fields.name: attributes.lastSyncRunAt
fields.description: Run start time as a millisecond UNIX timestamp. Integer, not a string date. Absent on Connection lines.

fields.name: attributes.lastSyncWorkflowName
fields.description: Workflow type that produced this asset. Absent on Connection lines.
